title: Gilbert Resort w/ Pool, Theater & MiniGolf•Sleep16
description:
🌵 Gilbert Getaway – Your Own Private Resort-Style Home w/ Theater, Pool, Hot Tub, Mini Golf & Billiards.

Planning a sun-filled family vacation, staycation with friends, or group trip for a special celebration?
Welcome to your own private resort in the heart of Gilbert, where days start with coffee in the backyard and end with sunset swims, movie nights, and s’mores under the stars.

 The space 
✅ Sleeps up to 16 | 5 Bedrooms + Game Room | 3 Bathrooms

Here’s what guests love most:

✔ Resort-style backyard w/ huge heated pool, hot tub, putting green, fire pit, cornhole, outdoor TV & grill station
✔ Private home theater with big screen + comfy recliners
✔ Game room w/ pool table, arcade-style basketball & more
✔ Fully stocked kitchen perfect for cooking big meals together
✔ Smart TVs in every bedroom + fast Wi-Fi throughout
✔ Super host-level service with fast, clear communication
✔ Quiet neighborhood, walkable & bike-friendly, with top restaurants, shops & attractions just minutes away

Sleep Setup:
🛏️ Bedroom 1 (Primary): King bed + ensuite bath
🛏️ Bedroom 2: King bed
🛏️ Bedroom 3: King bed
🛏️ Bedroom 4: Two full beds
🛏️ Bedroom 5: Queen bed
📽️ Theater Room: Multiple Queen air mattresses upon request
💤 Pack n Play 

Perfect for:
• Family reunions & multi-generational vacations
• Wedding weekends (close to venues like The Paseo, Villa Siena, Seville)
• Sports tournaments, golf trips & business retreats
• Locals looking for the ultimate staycation

Looking to explore? You're minutes from Topgolf, SanTan Village, Downtown Gilbert, Gilbert Regional Park, and endless dining, shopping, and hiking options.

📍 Bonus: Only 25 mins from Sky Harbor Airport!
📍 Bonus: Only 14 mins from Mesa Gateway Airport!
📍 Bonus: Only 20 mins from Arizona Athletic Grounds!

Whether you're in town for a wedding, tournament, or just to reconnect, this home has the space, amenities, and thoughtful touches to keep everyone entertained. From toddlers to grandparents—there’s something here for every age.

Your hosts are known for thoughtful details, smooth check-ins, and fast, friendly support. Whether you’re planning a quiet escape or a group gathering, they’ve got you covered.

 Guest access 
The house is exclusively yours, without interruption during your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Iron/Board
✔ Washer/Dryer
✔ Free Parking

 Other things to note 
★ NO PETS ALLOWED ★
We love those little (and not so little) furry bundles of joy. Sadly, our home is not suitable to accommodate them.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking/vaping inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in odor removal and furniture cleaning fees.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine
High chair - always at the listing
Pack ’n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
